import json,collections
p='answers.jsonl';a=[json.loads(s) for s in open(p)];c=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
a[54]['marks']='y';a[54]['errors'].remove('wrong_mark')
a[2]['errors']=['crop_overrun'];a[2]['segmentation_detail']='The word is turned 90 degrees; substantial partial letter bodies from a neighbouring line run beside it.'
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for r in a:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(c)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in a]==[r['card_id'] for r in c]
required={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
for r in a:
 assert required<=r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ('y','n','u') and r['marks'] in ('y','n','na') and r['crop_ok'] in ('y','n')
 assert set(r['owner_crop'])=={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
 assert all(v in ('yes','no','uncertain') for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(a))
for k in ('letters','marks','crop_ok'):print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in a)))
print('Top errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in a for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
